update_campaign.description: Update campaign. Returns one response page; the connected account determines access.
update_campaign.name: update_campaign

parameters.description: Id.
parameters.name: id

parameters.description: Campaign name. Maximum 255 characters.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: IANA timezone for the send/call windows (e.g. `America/New_York`).
parameters.name: timezone

parameters.description: 1 to 6 daily windows as objects with `start` and `end` in `HH:MM`. A window runs overnight when `end` is earlier than `start` (e.g. `16:00` → `02:00`). Replaces the current windows.
parameters.name: schedule_windows

parameters.description: Legacy single-window start (`HH:MM`). Sets the start of the first window when `schedule_windows` is not sent.
parameters.name: allowed_hours_start_time

parameters.description: Legacy single-window end (`HH:MM`). Sets the end of the first window when `schedule_windows` is not sent. Overnight when end \< start.
parameters.name: allowed_hours_end_time

parameters.description: Weekdays when calls or messages can go out: `monday` … `sunday`. At least one. Replaces the current days.
parameters.name: allowed_days

parameters.description: ISO 8601 date and time to start the campaign automatically. Without an offset it is read in the campaign timezone. The date cannot be before today. A campaign that isn't running (for example `draft`, `paused` or `completed`) becomes `scheduled` and starts by itself at that time. A running campaign keeps running. Set to `null` to clear it: a `scheduled` campaign goes back to `draft`.
parameters.name: scheduled_start_at

parameters.description: Max retry attempts per lead. Range: 1 to 5.
parameters.name: max_retries

parameters.description: Minutes between retries. Range: 10 to 4320.
parameters.name: retry_interval

parameters.description: `true` completes the campaign once every lead has been processed. `false` keeps it waiting for new leads, which campaigns fed by an automation or the API need. Turning it off doesn't reopen a campaign that has already completed: start it again with [Update campaign status](/api-reference/campaigns/update-status). #### Call campaigns
parameters.name: mark_complete_when_no_leads

parameters.description: An OUTBOUND assistant you own. Changing it also moves the campaign to that assistant's timezone, unless you send `timezone` in the same request. The goal variable is cleared if the new assistant doesn't have it as a True/False post-call variable.
parameters.name: assistant_id

parameters.description: Concurrent calls, up to your plan's limit (max 10).
parameters.name: max_calls_in_parallel

parameters.description: The numbers to call from. **Replaces the whole pool.** Send `[]` to remove all numbers; calls then use the assistant's own number. Numbers you add must be available to your account.
parameters.name: phone_number_ids

parameters.description: Retry when a call hits voicemail.
parameters.name: retry_on_voicemail

parameters.description: Keep retrying until the goal variable is true. Turning it off clears `goal_completion_variable`.
parameters.name: retry_on_goal_incomplete

parameters.description: A True/False (`bool`) post-call variable of the campaign's assistant, used with `retry_on_goal_incomplete`. It is cleared while `retry_on_goal_incomplete` is off.
parameters.name: goal_completion_variable

parameters.description: Text follow-up after the last call retry: `whatsapp` or `sms`. Set to `null` to turn the follow-up off, which also clears its settings. Switching between `whatsapp` and `sms` clears the settings of the other one.
parameters.name: fallback_channel

parameters.description: WhatsApp sender for the follow-up. A new sender also needs `fallback_whatsapp_template_id`.
parameters.name: fallback_whatsapp_sender_id

parameters.description: An approved template on that sender. Placeholders it shares with the current follow-up template keep their mapping; if it has other placeholders, send the full `fallback_variable_mapping` in the same request.
parameters.name: fallback_whatsapp_template_id

parameters.description: Maps every placeholder of the follow-up template (e.g. `"1"`) to a lead variable key, and nothing else.
parameters.name: fallback_variable_mapping

parameters.description: SMS-capable number for the follow-up, available to your account.
parameters.display_name: Fallback SMS from phone number ID
parameters.name: fallback_sms_from_phone_number_id

parameters.description: Follow-up SMS text. Max 1600 characters. Supports `{{variable}}` placeholders. #### WhatsApp campaigns

parameters.description: A sender you own. A new sender also needs `whatsapp_template_id`.
parameters.name: whatsapp_sender_id

parameters.description: An approved template on that sender. Placeholders it shares with the current template keep their mapping; if it has other placeholders, send the full `text_variable_mapping` in the same request.
parameters.name: whatsapp_template_id

parameters.description: Maps every template placeholder (e.g. `"1"`) to a lead variable key, and nothing else. Replaces the current mapping.
parameters.name: text_variable_mapping

parameters.description: Per-campaign send rate. Range: 1 to 10. #### SMS campaigns
